subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-party Control UI math rendering in core, and if so which implementation shape should be accepted for config, dependency, sanitizer, and proof requirements?
rationale: The request fits web frontend ergonomics, but accepting it creates a durable core UI rendering, config, dependency, and untrusted-output security contract that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor one current core implementation
options.body: Review one active candidate PR to completion with dependency/security approval, sanitizer review, compatibility coverage, and real Control UI proof, then close this issue after merge.

options.title: Require a narrower replacement design
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking contributors to replace the current candidates with a smaller markdown-stage design that minimizes config and sanitizer risk.

options.title: Decline first-party core support for now
options.body: Close this issue and the active candidate PRs as not planned, documenting that math rendering is not accepted as a core Control UI feature yet.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one current core implementation
recommendation.body: Review one active candidate PR to completion with dependency/security approval, sanitizer review, compatibility coverage, and real Control UI proof, then close this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/config/security-boundary choice, and steipete has original Control UI markdown history plus adjacent config, dependency, and release ownership signals.
